claim.value: Which orders exceeded the threshold and what the internal rule required at the relevant time must be verified.
claim.scope: Applicability and content of the historical internal rule; neither is supplied order by order.

provenance.rationale: P004 directly requires verification of threshold applicability and the rule in effect at the time.

signal_basis.value: Record order amounts, approval content, authority and distinct event and record dates; check whether approval documentation links to the order, precedes placement and meets the applicable authority requirement.
signal_basis.scope: Proposed checks on sampled orders, assumed executed for this assessment; the mapping does not report their results.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the sampled-order scope, recorded information, approval checks and prospective status of the observations.
No unresolved empirical relation is needed to warrant this verification requirement.

rationale: Assessing an order against a threshold-based historical rule requires establishing whether that rule applied and what it required at the time. The described checks therefore license this bounded verification requirement. The claim does not assert that any order violated or satisfied the rule.
uncertainty: Order-specific applicability and rule requirements remain to be verified; this does not undermine the warrant for requiring those checks.
